name: digiKam
tagline: Photo management desktop app, in a container
description: Professional photo management with face recognition, similar-image search, geotagging and RAW processing — via web-accessible noVNC session.
compose:
services:
  digikam:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/digikam:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3000"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
    security_opt:
      - seccomp:unconfined
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
      - /pictures:/pictures
    restart: unless-stopped
